_note: Single registry of every playlist. id=null means the playlist must be created on first run, then the id saved here. Order: 'forward' or 'reversed'. mode: how automation may touch it.

air_order.title: DJ Stace library show Air Order
air_order.mode: build draft; Stace edits by hand; her edits win

working.title: DJ Stace library show working
working.mode: mirror Air Order reversed; deltas only; flip with Sort > Newest first

weekly.title: Stace's Weekly Playlist
weekly.mode: ADD only; never clear; Stace deletes stale tracks; log her deletes (60-day cool-off)

fcc_edit_needed.title: FCC Edit Needed
fcc_edit_needed.mode: add strong tracks with FCC hits; label not airable 6am-10pm

next_show.title: DJ Stace - Next Show
next_show.mode: READ ONLY; snapshot and diff for new interests

to_review.title: To Review
to_review.mode: repopulate: albums with boilerplate requested (one-time reset of stale list needs Stace OK)

kzsu_current_adds.title: KZSU Current Adds
kzsu_current_adds.mode: refresh weekly from Zookeeper Current Adds, filtered by taste profile

archive_pattern.title: The Library Show on KZSU 90.1 Stanford, CA with DJ Stace ({Month} {d}, {yyyy} Show)
archive_pattern.mode: one new playlist per aired show, from Zookeeper log; always set a description (see kzsu-archive-playlist)

specialty_pattern.title: Library Specialty: {name} {yyyy}
specialty_pattern.mode: 2.5 hr suggestion playlist per seasonal or topical show

specialty_halloween_2026.title: Library Specialty: Halloween 2026
specialty_halloween_2026.mode: suggestion playlist for Oct. 29, 2026 show; Stace culls

_duplicate_to_delete.title: ZZ DUPLICATE Halloween (merge then delete)
_duplicate_to_delete.mode: duplicate created by a double click; all tracks merged into the main playlist; Stace deletes it
